_comment: Client registry for the multi-client (agency) setup.
add-client.sh reads and writes this file — you normally do not edit it by hand.
slug   : short id, lowercase, no spaces. Used for folder + PM2 name (zfc-<slug>).
domain : the public domain that runs in Meta ads for THIS client.
port   : internal Node port. Nginx proxies domain -> 127.0.0.1:port.
label  : human-readable client name, shown by --list.
One entry = one fully isolated app instance with its own data.json,
own Telegram bot token, own Meta pixel. Nothing is shared between clients.
